# Baseline profile for the StreamDek Mobile app.
#
# Captured with `cmd package dump-profiles --dump-classes-and-methods net.streamdek.mobile`
# after three cold launches through the version gate, the profile picker and Home, on an
# Android 16 device.
#
# What it adds, and what was already there. A release build already shipped a baseline profile -
# but only the ~17KB the AndroidX libraries contribute to it. Compose's own internals were
# compiled ahead of time; the 7,300-odd methods of this app's own code that run on the way to the
# picker were not, on a launch path that is almost entirely this app's own code. That is what the
# picker's entrance was competing with: frame captures put 122ms and 158ms on the two frames that
# should have been the reveal, and since the reveal clock runs in wall-clock time the animation
# was most of the way through by the second frame drawn - which is why it appeared to stutter and
# then snap into place.
#
# It matters more here than it would in most apps. StreamDek installs from a downloaded APK
# rather than from Play, so there is no cloud profile to fill the gap, and Android's own
# background dexopt only runs on idle and charging - a viewer who updates and opens the app
# straight away never gets it.
#
# AGP merges this with the libraries' profiles, rewrites the names through R8's mapping, and
# compiles the result into assets/dexopt/baseline.prof. It does not need recapturing when
# obfuscation changes - only when the launch path itself moves.
